name: brainpet-codex-bridge
description: Privately mirrors Codex lifecycle state to the local BrainPet runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex task states to BrainPet.
interface.longDescription: Sends only local lifecycle state and ephemeral session identifiers to BrainPet. Prompt, response, transcript, and workspace contents are not forwarded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how BrainPet mirrors local Codex task status.
